retry_reasons: The overview guide still told agents to pass a Workflow ID to workflow show, which now fails
The help of the default_workflow setting still said it selects a Workflow
An existing board with the old per-ID workflow files silently fell back to the default without a warning
A lint config comment gave a reason that the removed ACTION_NAMES export made untrue
The development document still named the software-development Workflow
A web store comment still referred to template names and labels
Requirements 5.8 did not say that transitions, reconcile, and fields are still read
The ADR listed permission values and per-item details whose canonical source is the schema
